channel.title: Josh Wright
channel.description: Notes on building products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure by Josh Wright.

item.title: Azure AI Search, Managed Identity and SQL Failover Groups: Does ResourceId Matter?
item.description: Testing whether Azure AI Search indexers using Managed Identity survive SQL Failover Group failovers and server replacements when ResourceId points to a single server.

item.title: ASP.NET Data Protection on Kubernetes: Why It Matters and How to Get It Right
item.description: Why ASP.NET Data Protection keys break across Kubernetes pods and deployments, and how to persist and protect them with Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, and AKS Workload Identity.

item.title: Seamless NuGet Authentication to Azure DevOps Artifacts from Dockerfile
item.description: Authenticate multi-stage .NET Docker builds against private Azure Artifacts NuGet feeds using the Azure Artifacts Credential Provider and pipeline job access tokens.

item.title: Create Dynamic Azure DevOps Variable Insertion when using Templates
item.description: How to pass an object parameter and use the ${{ insert }} expression in Azure DevOps YAML templates for dynamic variable injection and token replacement.
